facts.text: "Rule one, no killing anybody. Rule two, you can eat the quesadillas. Come on, Terminator."
facts.why: John never says this. It is in quote marks and signed John Connor, so it reads as a film line. His famous rule is that the Terminator cannot go around killing people. The wording below is a line from the quote page I opened.
facts.fix: Now don't take this the wrong way, but you are a Terminator, right?

fix_note.text: Now don't take this the wrong way, but you are a Terminator, right?

facts.text: Salceda's place. Guns in the ground, beer in the esky.
facts.why: Enrique's desert camp is real and Sarah sends the Terminator and John on weapons detail, but no source shows buried guns or beer in an esky. Enrique offers the Terminator a bottle of booze.
facts.fix: Salceda's place. Weapons detail, and a drink if you want one.
